name: lines
description: A web GUI for coding agents: run, watch and steer multiple Claude Code or Codex sessions in parallel, while the agent runs on your own machine.
author: Vytautas Butkus

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web,storage -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w storage"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w relay && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w storage && npm run typecheck -w desktop
